title: Structural inference for an iridium nitrato complex from molecular evidence and IR
difficulty_reasons: Composition and a limited IR record need not uniquely specify coordination or ligand geometry.
Molecular models and experimental observations require scientifically justified comparison and uncertainty handling.

data.description: Full complex composition and unassigned experimental KBr band observations, including reported qualitative strengths and source discrepancy.

required_deliverables.description: Structured investigation with actual evidence, units, identities, conclusions and limits.
Readable scientific report with auditable artifact links.
